text:
rachel_sales: Quick handoff for SentinelPay pilot (signed). Key points: embeddings-heavy (~2.2M tokens/mo) + some realtime chat paths, migrating from a competitor (need data import of historical vectors), Okta SSO, customer-managed KMS, HIPAA + SOC2 requirements. They want Private VPC evaluation within 30 days and firm renewal check at 45 days. Contract & migration notes in drive: https://drive.internal/sentinelpay/handbook.pdf. Who owns API/infra rollout? cc @priya_cs @victor_cs_manager

priya_cs: Taking point. Can we do a 20m kickoff tomorrow 2pm PT? I'll publish onboarding checklist + risk register. Need expected QPS, p99 target, typical seq len, and confirmation on data import format. Also flagging renewal-watch. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-9310 and linked ENG-4527. Kickoff scheduled for 02:00 PM PT tomorrow.

otto_support: Private deploy note: we'll need an executed support addendum for on-prem/private, and an infra owner contact for VPN/firewall whitelisting. I'll start the infra-handoff checklist and open support ticket ENG-4527. Also need dataset transfer plan for vector import (S3 presigned or rsync?).

mina_eng: Perf planning: for p99 <=180ms at sustained 60 qps recommend 2xA10-equivalent plus warm KV cache strategy. If they import large historical vectors, we should shard embeddings and plan warmup to avoid cold-cache spikes. Need embedding dim and sample vector sizes. Also, if chat paths use context windows >1024, memory grows - may recommend quantization.

rachel_sales: Customer targets: p99 170ms for <512 tokens, avg 60 qps with spikes to 140 qps for 10-15min, embedding dim 2048, historical vector set ~120M vectors (will be staged in S3). They insist on KMS and thorough audit logs. I'll upload sample schema and S3 manifest tonight.

priya_cs: Opening CS-9310. Proposed owners: priya_cs (CS lead), otto_support (support), mina_eng (runtime), rachel_sales (sales contact). Next steps I captured: 1) Customer shares Okta metadata + KMS ARN + S3 manifest for vectors; 2) Support to confirm support addendum and infra contacts; 3) SRE to provision staging private pool (3 GPUs) for data import + smoke; 4) Perf sweep + data-import dry run; 5) Enablement + runbook handoff. I suggested 3-week pilot runway to reduce renewal risk.

victor_cs_manager: Flagging as RENEWAL_CRITICAL (45-day window). If any delays on data import or staging, consider offering a brief production credit and a dedicated onboarding SRE shift. Please tag finance/RevOps for credit approval.

otto_support: We can support a 10-day monitoring window for a trial, but need S3 access + read-only telemetry endpoints. Also request a point of contact for customer's security team to sign the addendum. Filing subtask ENG-4527-1 for data import runbook.

mina_eng: Once S3 manifest and a small sample are uploaded I'll run a perf sweep and a simulated import in staging, then post numbers to ENG-4527. If memory/IO are bottlenecks we may propose a staged import + hot-shard strategy.

rachel_sales: Uploading S3 manifest + sample vectors now. Inviting SentinelPay infra/security to the kickoff.

priya_cs: Added owners to CS-9310 and set these immediate owners: @otto_support open ENG-4527-1 for import runbook; @mina_eng perf sweep after sample; @victor_cs_manager loop RevOps for credits; @rachel_sales confirm S3 creds and Okta metadata. I'll send kickoff agenda (data import focus). :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: CS-9310 linked to ENG-4527 and ENG-4527-1. Reminders set for go/no-go checkpoints.

victor_cs_manager: Acknowledged. If p99 >200ms post-sweep we escalate to infra prioritization. Keep me posted after the perf sweep.

priya_cs: Closing loop for now 1 will update after kickoff and initial dry run. Thanks team :thumbsup:
